page_meta.title: Workforce & Field Operations | SZ Ventures
page_meta.headline: THE INFRASTRUCTURE BEHIND DISTRIBUTED WORK.
page_meta.description: SZ Ventures builds and operates distributed workforces for companies that need people on the ground. From recruitment and verification to deployment, execution and quality control.

capabilities.title: Workforce Deployment
capabilities.headline: SCALE FIELD CAPACITY WITH VERIFIED OPERATORS.
capabilities.short_description: Recruit, onboard and deploy distributed workers for operational requirements.
capabilities.description: We establish structured field workforces calibrated to client requirements, handling end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, and local supervisory coordination.

capabilities.title: Rider Operations
capabilities.headline: DEDICATED RIDERS. MANAGED BY SZ.
capabilities.short_description: Dedicated delivery workforce for businesses requiring managed rider operations.
capabilities.description: We recruit, onboard and manage delivery riders for businesses requiring dedicated in-house delivery capacity with reliable shifts, vehicle readiness, and active route supervision.

capabilities.title: BGV & Field Verification
capabilities.headline: VERIFICATION THAT HAPPENS IN THE REAL WORLD.
capabilities.short_description: Distributed personnel for background verification, address verification and physical verification.
capabilities.description: Distributed field personnel for location-dependent verification requirements, collecting physical documentation, confirming geographic coordinates, and auditing onsite data.

capabilities.title: Field Gig Operations
capabilities.headline: PEOPLE ON THE GROUND. WHEN THE WORK NEEDS THEM.
capabilities.short_description: Deployable field workforce for physical, location-dependent tasks.
capabilities.description: Rapidly deployable field contributors for physical tasks that cannot be completed remotely, executed according to strict standard operating procedures and geotagged audits.

capabilities.title: Device & Asset Recovery
capabilities.headline: RELIABLE ASSET RETRIEVAL AND REVERSE LOGISTICS.
capabilities.short_description: Field personnel for device collection, asset pickup, recovery and related operational tasks.
capabilities.description: Trained field personnel for collecting, recovering, transferring, and validating physical enterprise hardware and leased assets across distributed geographic locations.

capabilities.title: On-Demand Field Teams
capabilities.headline: DYNAMIC PHYSICAL EXECUTION ACROSS LOCATIONS.
capabilities.short_description: Flexible distributed teams for surveys, audits, inspections, data collection and other field requirements.
capabilities.description: Flexible, multi-disciplinary distributed teams mobilized for enterprise initiatives requiring burst capacity, geographic spread, and high-fidelity real-world data collection.

process.name: Requirement
process.description: Client defines the task scope, location parameters, and SLAs.

process.name: Workforce
process.description: SZ sources suitable personnel aligned with task complexity.

process.name: Verification
process.description: Personnel are onboarded, trained, and verified for the assignment.

process.name: Deployment
process.description: Workers are assigned to territories, rosters, and specific routes.

process.name: Execution
process.description: Work is performed according to defined SOPs and protocols.

process.name: Quality Control
process.description: Evidence, geotags, timestamps, and outputs are systematically reviewed.

process.name: Delivery
process.description: Validated outputs and real-time operational reports are delivered.
